notes: The staging equivalent of production-api-overlay-plan.json sql_prerequisites[].verified_live, and nothing else: which SQL files are recorded as applied and verified in the staging database. scripts/deployment-guard/github-staging-lambda-overlay.mjs reads it in apply mode: a staging overlay of a member whose production plan entry has sql_before is refused (DEPLOYMENT_COLLISION, before any AWS call) until that file is recorded here with verified_live true. A file missing here counts as not live. Set verified_live true only in a reviewed change that names the guarded staging SQL executor apply (or read-live) run as evidence. It authorizes nothing: production keeps its own record in production-api-overlay-plan.json. Every sql_before value of the plan must have an entry (aws/tests/github-staging-lambda-overlay.test.mjs).
